    How to use

    Drag a knob up or down (hold Shift for fine). Mouse wheel works too. Click a value to type it. Double-click a knob to reset it to the loaded preset. Drag the filter points (cutoff and low cut) and the envelope nodes directly. Pink dots mark what you moved. Pages: Sound, Mod (matrix), FX, Presets and waves.
